title: Functional fine-mapping of noncoding risk variants in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis utilizing convolutional neural network.
summary: The analysis of 14,791 ALS cases and 26,898 controls across 41 strata nominated two variant/gene candidates with lymphoblastoid eQTL support. These are computational candidates, not demonstrated causal variants or mechanisms in ALS.
ai_technology: A convolutional neural network combined functional genomic annotations with eQTL evidence to prioritize noncoding ALS risk variants and candidate genes.
organization: Interdisciplinary Program, Bioengineering Major, Seoul National University; MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, Cambridge; KAIST
